row:
I help aspiring and new massage therapists and other healthcare practitioners confidently start and grow their own massage therapy practices and businesses, without sacrificing their work-life balance ⚖️, personal health 🏋️‍♀️, and well-being 🧘‍♂️. 

Through tutorials 🎥, vlogs 📹, and podcasts 🎙️, I share practical advice and strategies drawn from my own experience running a home-based massage therapy business.

I guide massage therapy students in preparing for their MCQ and OSCE exams, offering tips and resources to help them study smarter and pass with confidence.

Visit 👉 getmyostudybuddy.com 👈  to access study support, learning tools, and business insights to help you succeed — from classroom to clinic to your own thriving practice 🚀.
